name: Meta Quest 3

desc.en: The Quest 3 is the most well-rounded standalone headset: sharp pancake lenses, quality color passthrough, and the best VR app ecosystem. No PC or console required — the top pick by specialized media in 2024–2025.
desc.es: El Quest 3 es el headset standalone más equilibrado: lentes pancake de alta nitidez, passthrough color de calidad y el mejor ecosistema de apps VR. Sin PC ni consola — el más recomendado por medios especializados en 2024–2025.

schema_description: The most well-rounded standalone VR headset of 2024–2025. Features Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2, pancake lenses with 2064×2208 resolution per eye, and full color mixed reality passthrough. No PC or console required.
